user.title: Your club
user.description: Type the name of your club (or its 8-digit Ten'Up code).

cookie.title: Ten'Up session
cookie.description:
Ten'Up does not allow logging in with a password from an integration, so it needs your session.

Club: {club} ({club_code}).

**1. [Open your club grid]({club_url})** in a new tab and log in with your FFT credentials. That is the **Book at my club** page: the bookmarklet only works from there, not from the {site} home page. Leave it open.

**2.** Still on the Ten'Up tab, click your **Ten'Up session** bookmarklet: it copies the session to your clipboard.

Do not have it yet? Create a bookmark whose address is this line, keeping the `javascript:` prefix (some browsers drop it when it is pasted):

```
{bookmarklet}
```{install_page}

**3.** Come back here and paste the session in the field below.
